name: Rice cakes
summary: Cồn Sơn’s garden kitchens make the delta’s folk cakes: bánh bò lụi, bánh ít, bánh bột lọc, bánh lá mít, bánh da lợn, bánh đúc, bánh xèo, and bánh khọt. Market stalls sell small rice cakes wrapped in banana leaves, some coloured with pandan and sweetened with coconut or mung bean.
origin: Cồn Sơn islet and the delta markets.
howToEat: Eat them in the garden on Cồn Sơn, or buy them from a market stall.
seoDescription: Cồn Sơn’s folk cakes, from bánh bò lụi to bánh khọt, and banana-leaf rice cakes with pandan, coconut, or mung bean.
